'''Steve Kuperman TIGIH Scouts as told by Crazy Hermit''' is the [[Light]] constructed list [[Steve Kuperman]] posted on DeckTech.<ref name="dt-13607">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/13607 TIGIH Scouts  as told by Crazy Hermit], DeckTech (Steve "Crazy Hermit" Kuperman, 12 February 2001). Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/13607/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/13607/ GitHub Pages]; [https://web.archive.org/web/20261018052646/https://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/13607/ Wayback Machine].</ref>

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Steve Kuperman]]
* '''Published:''' 12 February 2001 (DeckTech)
* '''Published title:''' ''TIGIH Scouts  as told by Crazy Hermit''
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Reflections II]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|There Is Good In Him / I Can Save Him|DS2-L-thereisgoodinhim.gif|label=There Is Good In Him}}
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PR2 TIGIH Kuperman LS 2001 DeckTech.txt |Download]] (omits Cloud City East Platform: not in GEMP)
* '''Strategy:''' There's been plenty of them, but this one takes a bunch of the decktype's weaknesses and eliminates them.
